key_insight: Epitaxial 0.5PZT-0.5PFN thin films show polarization-switchable photocurrent, indicating strong coupling between ferroelectric order and photovoltaic response.
engineering_relevance: These single-phase multiferroic films are promising for polarization-controlled photovoltaic devices and optoelectronic memory elements.
method: Grown by pulsed laser deposition on SrTiO3 (001) with a SrRuO3 bottom electrode.
Confirmed single perovskite phase and strong (001) texture.
Measured ferroelectric, magnetic, and photocurrent response under 403 nm illumination.
evidence_signal: The films showed remanent polarization of about 17 μC/cm², weak ferromagnetism at room temperature, and polarization-dependent Jsc values up to ±20 μA/cm².
watch_item: The reported photoresponse is demonstrated under monochromatic laser illumination, so device performance under full solar spectrum and long-term operating conditions still needs validation.
paper_title: Enhanced Photocurrent Response in Epitaxial 0.5PZT-0.5PFN Multiferroic Thin Films
